title: Attorney General of Alabama

context.text: The seat is open: Ballotpedia lists no incumbent in this race. Robertson won the June 16, 2026 Republican runoff with about 56% over former Alabama Supreme Court Justice Jay Mitchell; McLaughlin was unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

candidates.name: Katherine Robertson
candidates.ballotNote: Won the June 16, 2026 Republican primary runoff.
candidates.currentRole: Chief counsel to Attorney General Steve Marshall
candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website or detailed policy statements were reached, so no priorities or positions are listed; she has not held elected office, so no record items are listed. The Alabama Political Reporter notes the primary included allegations by Mitchell's campaign about dark-money spending against her.

candidates.name: Jeff McLaughlin

priorities.text: Campaign finance reform; he is described as having refused campaign contributions during his time in the Alabama House.

candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website or platform on the guide's issues found. His legislative record (2000s) was not researched, so no record items are listed.
